units.title: problem_set_1
examples: S-wave delay from a velocity anomaly over a 300 km layer
time for a P wave to cross the Earth, Moon and Sun from rough velocity profiles
water depths and depth to a magma chamber from two-way times on a seismic reflection section

units.title: problem_set_2
examples: reflection and transmission coefficients against incidence angle at an interface (Zoeppritz)

units.title: problem_set_3
examples: travel time for a linear velocity gradient: circular rays; T against distance

units.title: problem_set_4
examples: group and phase velocity of Rayleigh waves from peak and trough times at two stations
receiver function: Ps − P delay for a converter at depth; depth from a measured delay
